question: Below what share of rated capacity does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life under the USABC standard?
rendered: According to the document, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity is less than 80% of the rated capacity, under the US Advanced Battery Consortium (USABC) standard.
